note: Field base offsets, one per (opcode, length). A field holds (value - base) / step; the base is what the field's bits do not account for, read from a DECODE of the form's own witness so that reconstruction is not circular. Harvested here once so that a compile does not fork Apple's disassembler - tools/agx3dis is untracked, and an image built with it cannot be rebuilt from this repository alone. The key is 'opcode,length', with an empty length for the opcode-wide entry.
